captcha.recaptcha: Google reCAPTCHA v2 checkbox widget rendered with the site key of form-config

views.form: Type selector first; the fields, options, consent, anti-automation check and submit button appear once a type is chosen.

confirmation.heading: Prijava je sprejeta
confirmation.text: Vašo prijavo smo prejeli. Potrditev smo poslali na vaš e-poštni naslov.

failure.notReceived: Prijave nismo prejeli. Poskusite znova pozneje.
failure.tooManyRequests: Preveč poskusov. Počakajte trenutek in poskusite znova.
failure.loadFailed: Obrazca ni bilo mogoče naložiti. Osvežite stran.

rules: Every control is reachable by its label (accessible name); every option checkbox is labelled with the option's display name.
A group in optionGroups is shown only when it has at least one active option; groups keep the order above.
On submit the frontend checks required, maxLength and email format first and sends nothing while a check fails (NFR-03).
A field error is shown directly after its control, linked with aria-describedby, and the control has aria-invalid=true.
Backend field errors (400) are shown at the control named by `field`; entered values stay in the form.
The confirmation view replaces the form only after the API answered 201 (BR-06).
Any answer other than 201, 400 and 429, or no answer, shows failure.notReceived and keeps the form.
The frontend calls only paths under /api (AR-01) and holds no key except the reCAPTCHA site key from form-config (AR-07).
